Subject: Quick ask — can you keep our pilot live while PO clears?

Hi Vanessa,

Appreciate the demo last week — the team was excited to start a fuller evaluation. We’re finalizing an internal PO but procurement hit an extra vendor onboarding step (security questionnaire + legal review) so paperwork will slip into next week.

Can Redwood provision a short interim credit (two weeks) or a small token top-up so our engineers can keep the sandbox running while procurement finishes? We expect the PO to arrive by 11/09. I attached the draft PO the finance team prepared.

Basic ask: 2-week sandbox credit (~75k tokens equivalent) and a 14-day extension on the trial seat. We’re happy to share any additional info you need for approvals.

Thanks — we want to keep momentum going.

— Olivia

If we make it conditional on receipt of the signed PO draft and a confirmed delivery date, we can protect the business while keeping the deal warm. I recommend:
- Provision 50k tokens today (expires 2026-11-17)
- Auto-top-up 25k when PO is received (apply toward first invoice)

Marissa — please add the conditional language to the MAP and mark the lead stage so CS knows to keep the demo infra running.

— Ben
